title: autotune: cost-optimization defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Alicia Chen
description:
Context: This PR implements the next phase of cost-optimization automation: sensible defaults for batching and KV-prefix caching, a small set of quantization profiles for common CPU/GPU targets, and the first-pass unit-economics tooling that surfaces token-level cost estimates in the Console.

Summary: 1) Add an autotune defaults module that computes per-model default batch sizes and cache policies from historical latency/seq-length distributions. 2) Introduce 3 quant profiles (fp16, int8-q4, int8-q4_0) and mapping rules for hardware/latency tradeoffs. 3) Expose a unit-econ endpoint and Console widget that estimates per-request token cost and expected throughput given current autoscale/batching settings.

Why: Customers repeatedly ask for low-friction levers to reduce inference unit cost without manual tuning. Automating sensible defaults and surfacing unit economics reduces operational overhead and NRE for onprem/dedicated installs.

What changed (high level): - runtime/autotune: default estimator and policy engine; heuristic + simple bayesian prior for low-sample models. - runtime/quant: quant profile registry + selection heuristics. - console/backend: unit-econ API and background evaluator. - console/frontend: per-route unit-econ widget and recommendations. - docs: how-to guide for autotune and quant profiles. - tests/bench: new microbench harness and CI integration.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc: ENG-4242 linked - [x] Unit tests for estimator - [x] Integration test in canary lab - [x] Console UI + E2E - [x] Benchmarks show median cost reduction ~12% across common workloads - [x] Security review (no new secrets)
commits: feat(autotune): add default estimator and policy engine
feat(quant): add quant profile registry and selection heuristics
feat(console): add unit-econ API and widget
test: add autotune unit tests and bench harness
review_comments: Marcus Li (review): overall approach LGTM. Two nit requests: 1) make the fallback for low-sample models explicit; 2) add a tiny synthetic test to exercise seq-length corner cases.
Alicia Chen (author): addressed both; added bayesian prior and synthetic seq-length test.
Priya Nair (review): please add a short note in docs about quant profile accuracy expectations on CPUs vs A100s.
Alicia Chen (author): added docs note and small benchmark table comparing fp16 vs int8-q4 on T4/A100/cpu.
Samir Patel (review - perf): bench numbers look good, but we should gate the console recommendation rollout behind a feature flag. Requesting the flag + telemetry to track adoption.
Alicia Chen (author): added feature flag 'autotune.unit_econ_recs' and initial telemetry events (uecon_shown, uecon_applied).
ci_checks: bench: median cost -12%, p95 latency +2% (within SLO)
release_notes: Introduce autotune defaults for batching and KV-prefix caching to reduce per-token cost by default.
Add three quantization profiles (fp16, int8-q4, int8-q4_0) and automatic selection heuristics.
Expose unit-economics endpoint and Console widget to estimate per-request cost and recommend config changes.
